text: {"distance_m": 7, "reasoning_short": "This is an estimate from typical contrast-threshold data, not a precise figure. A 20/20 eye resolves about 1 arcmin of detail at full contrast. Approximate Blackwell-type thresholds at indoor light levels suggest a 30% contrast spot needs to span roughly 2 arcmin, about 5.8e-4 rad. Distance = 0.004 m / 5.8e-4 ≈ 7 m."}
